purpose: Complete families inspected with the actual unchanged baseline articles to assess broad displayed book/bird/flower labels against the five new support words. Direct exclusions on new articles prevent these broad labels from being offered as supposedly wrong alternatives.
limits: Exclusions guard ambiguous labels, not unrestricted synonym substitution. Book/volume senses, the bird sense and the flower sense are selected; other senses and spelling notes remain intact in the packet. Baseline article claims unrelated to these labels were not re-reviewed or rewritten.
